description: This file contains the class ErrorResponseAssert, which provides custom assertion methods for ErrorResponse objects in test cases, including checks for headers, status code, exception contents, and specific properties.

classes.name: ErrorResponseAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class extending AbstractAssert to facilitate testing of ErrorResponse objects, providing methods to verify headers, status code, exception type, and error codes.

methods.name: ErrorResponseAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assertion object with an ErrorResponse instance.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks if the ErrorResponse contains the expected DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasEmptyDittoHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that the ErrorResponse has empty DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Checks if the ErrorResponse has the specified correlation ID.

methods.name: hasType
methods.description: Verifies that the ErrorResponse's type matches the expected type.

methods.name: hasStatusCode
methods.description: Verifies that the ErrorResponse's HTTP status code matches the expected status.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks that the ErrorResponse contains the expected DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: containsDittoRuntimeExceptionOfType
methods.description: Verifies that the contained DittoRuntimeException is of the specified type.

methods.name: dittoRuntimeExceptionHasErrorCode
methods.description: Checks that the contained DittoRuntimeException has the expected error code.

methods.name: assertThatEquals
methods.description: Helper method to assert equality of two properties with a custom error message.
